component.name: Realer Xpad
component.summary: Sticky notes with Markdown and drawing

description.p: Quick little notes that stick to your desktop. Realer Xpad renders Markdown as you type, turns task lists into clickable checkboxes and lets you draw on any note with a pen, highlighter and eraser.

ul.li: Live Markdown with a clean read view
Drawing with stylus pressure and undo
Seven note colours with light and dark variants
Wayland-native, with Hyprland integration for floating and pinning notes

screenshot.caption: Notes in dark mode next to the notes manager

ul.li: The tray icon shows the logo in every tray, including Qt Quick bars that showed a placeholder
Rectangle and ellipse tool icons are outlines again on newer GTK versions
Always-visible tool row: text, pen, highlighter, shapes and eraser, replacing the separate draw mode
New shapes: line, arrow, rectangle and ellipse
Keeps running in the background like xpad, with a tray icon to show, hide and create notes
Hyprland 0.55+ Lua config support, with an example in extras/hyprland.lua
Deleting a hidden note from the notes manager now asks right there
Import your notes from xpad: offered on first start, and any time from the notes manager or with "realer-xpad import-xpad"
Reopening the notes manager after closing it now works reliably
The cursor of an empty note now lines up with the "Start typing" hint
Colour, ink and menu popovers take on the note's colour
Colour dots are ringed with their accent so every colour is easy to see
The pin button uses a bundled icon, so it shows with any icon theme
